description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on end wall. Seating: a sofa in the central living zone facing the TV/wall area, oriented toward the centre of the room. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom in a central position within the apartment. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; wheelchair users due to narrow elongated layout and turning corridor; households needing a home office or dedicated work desk; people requiring abundant natural light in sleeping areas.
